text:
Rae: Quick UX flag from today's review: bulk import can leave duplicate numeric priorities; the list just stacks rules with no hint. Thinking a small inline "Ordering nudge" pill that surfaces count + a Resolve shortcut. Josie: +1. Pill must be keyboard focusable (tabindex=0), role=button, and announced via aria-live when it appears. Example announce: "Priority conflict between 'A' and 'B'. Press Enter to resolve." Omar: On the sim side, resolving should trigger an incremental sim only for the affected route. We can accept a route-delta PATCH and avoid full project run. Leah: Copy: pill label "Ordering issue (2)"; modal title "Resolve ordering"; primary actions Move up / Move down; secondary Merge behind a More menu. Merge needs confirmation and clear tooltip explaining behavior. Rae: Modal should be light, trap focus, Esc closes and returns focus to pill. Show a compact side-by-side of conditions and a tiny match-order preview. Josie: Add aria-live snippet to checklist:
Priority conflict between "Signup" and "Paid"
. Also ensure pluralization for SRs. ui-bot: Uploaded mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1718901234-order-nudge.png Omar: Dev notes: PATCH /routes/:id/resolve-order {action:"move_up|move_down|merge", target_rule_id: "uuid", sim_apply: true} -> returns route_delta. Also add POST /routes/:id/ordering-preview for non-committal preview. Leah: Next steps: Josie adds a11y copy & tests; Omar specs API; Rae prototypes pill+modal and demos at next UX sync.
